entities.name: Second Temple
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Rebuilt after the Babylonian Exile (c. 516 BCE) under Zerubbabel, later magnificently expanded by Herod the Great (20 BCE–). The center of Jewish religious, political, and economic life during the Second Temple period. Destroyed by Rome in 70 CE, ending the sacrificial system.
